They are one of two professional clubs which are based in the city of Eindhoven, the other one being [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]]. FC Eindhoven play their home games at [[Jan Louwers Stadion]], in the southern part of the city. The club's official colours are blue and white, hence their nickname "{{lang|nl|Blauw-Witten}}" ({{lit|The Blue-Whites}})."}}
